text:
Let a study job pin the studied system its request names, so a second system can be studied beside firstmate. Today the config holds a single repo_url and repo_ref under [capabilities.study] (crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, the study capability struct; athena.toml points it at firstmate), and pinning in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs reads only that pair, with the pin.json override honouring only studies with that URL. Part 2 S1 of BRIEF.md requires firstmate, then Hermes Agent, then Athena, each pinned to a recorded SHA.
Plan: (1) Add an optional table [capabilities.study.systems.<name>] with repo_url and repo_ref; the existing single pair stays valid and is treated as one system named after its repository. (2) A study request must name exactly one configured system; a request naming none or several stops before dispatch, listing the configured names. (3) The existing pin.json override still wins for the system whose URL it records. (4) A pinned job's check environment carries ATHENA_PIN_URL and ATHENA_PIN_SHA, matching job.json. Do not edit athena.toml in this job: the schema must land before any config uses it.
Acceptance:
- cargo test: a config with systems.firstmate and systems.hermes-agent parses, and the repository's own athena.toml parses unchanged.
- cargo test (fake pinner): a request to study hermes agent's work handling pins Hermes at its configured ref; a firstmate request still pins the SHA in studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json, not repo_ref.
- cargo test: a study request naming no configured system, or two, stops before dispatch with a message listing the names, and no producer invocation is recorded.
- cargo test: a pinned job's check environment has ATHENA_PIN_URL and ATHENA_PIN_SHA equal to job.json's pin; the existing run_pin_tests pass unmodified.
- clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check are clean; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Out of scope: athena.toml changes, hiding one study from another's jobs, and the site.
